name: application-streak-calendar
title: Streak Calendar
description: Consecutive-day activity streak card: a flame icon with the current streak count, and a 7-day row showing active, missed, and today's state.
useWhen: Motivating daily habit or engagement streaks (learning apps, fitness trackers, daily check-ins).
You want a compact week view rather than a full month grid, since streaks are usually assessed over the recent past.
Distinct from Heatmap Calendar, which shows month-long intensity buckets rather than a short, gamified consecutive-day streak.
avoidWhen: You need to show a full month or year of activity history — use Heatmap Calendar instead.
The product has no daily-cadence habit loop — a streak framing adds pressure without a clear behavior to reinforce.
responsiveBehavior: The 7-column day grid stays fixed at 7 columns and shrinks each cell proportionally on narrow viewports rather than wrapping to fewer columns.
accessibility: Each day cell's status is conveyed by both fill/outline styling and a visible glyph or label (a checkmark, a dot, or the word "Today"), not color alone.
The flame icon is decorative; the streak count is stated as literal text ("12 day streak"), which is the actual accessible information.
Day-of-week labels use the same abbreviation scheme in both variants for consistency across light/dark contexts.

variants.title: Streak Calendar
variants.description: A 12-day streak card with a flame icon, five active (checkmark) days, one missed (dot) day, and today shown with an outlined 'Today' cell.
accessibility: Active, missed, and today states are each conveyed by a distinct visible glyph or label, not fill color alone.

variants.title: Streak Calendar (Dark)
variants.description: The same 12-day streak card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Active-day fill, missed-day muting, and the today outline remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
